title: Redis client, S3 presign utility, and geo utilities
description: Set up infrastructure clients and geo utilities. Create Redis client singleton with config. Create S3 presign utility for generating PUT URLs. Implement geo utilities: getCityCoords (Redis hash lookup) and haversineDistance (pure math). Create geoBootstrap script that reads data/us-cities.csv and populates the geo:cities Redis hash at API startup. Create the data/us-cities.csv file with a representative sample of US city centroids. See TDD §8.5 for geo implementation and PRD §9 for S3 presigned URL flow. Files in hussle-app-dispatch-api/src/shared/ and hussle-app-dispatch-api/src/config/.
acceptanceCriteria: hussle-app-dispatch-api/src/shared/redisClient.ts exports a configured Redis client singleton using REDIS_URL from env config
hussle-app-dispatch-api/src/config/s3.ts exports S3 client configured with AWS_REGION
hussle-app-dispatch-api/src/shared/s3Presign.ts exports generatePresignedPutUrl(bucket, key, contentType, maxSize) returning { url, key, expiresAt } with 15-minute expiry
S3 key structure follows pattern: {orgId}/loads/{loadId}/{type}/{filename} or {orgId}/carriers/{carrierId}/{type}/{filename}
hussle-app-dispatch-api/src/shared/geoLookup.ts exports getCityCoords(redis, state, city) returning { lat, lng } | null from geo:cities hash
Redis hash key format: 'geo:cities', field format: '{STATE}:{city_lowercase}'
hussle-app-dispatch-api/src/shared/geoLookup.ts exports haversineDistance(lat1, lng1, lat2, lng2) returning distance in miles (R=3959)
hussle-app-dispatch-api/src/config/geoBootstrap.ts reads data/us-cities.csv and bulk-loads into geo:cities Redis hash
data/us-cities.csv exists with at least 100 representative US city entries (format: state,city,lat,lng)
haversineDistance unit test: known city pair within 1% accuracy (per cross-feature decision L-006)
Accepted file types for S3: PDF, PNG, JPG, JPEG. Max sizes: PDF 5MB, others 10MB
validationCommand: cd hussle-app-dispatch-api && npx jest && npx tsc --noEmit
